sn34.16:1.1: pavaro cāti || || Sāvatthi || || Cattāro me bhikkhave jhāyī || || Katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismim samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || || [catukotikaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ] || || samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca || || Tatra || pa || pavaro cāti || || Sāvatthi || ||
